content:
Balaji Amines Limited is a prominent specialty chemical manufacturing company headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur – 413001, Maharashtra, India. Established with a vision to deliver high-quality chemical products that meet global standards, the company has emerged as a trusted name in the Indian chemical industry. Specializing in the production of amines and allied chemical derivatives, Balaji Amines Limited caters to diverse sectors including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, dyes and pigments, water treatment, and polymers, serving both domestic and international markets.

The company operates out of a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility equipped with advanced technology and adheres to stringent quality control protocols. Committed to innovation, sustainability, and environmental responsibility, Balaji Amines Limited employs eco-friendly production processes and strictly complies with statutory regulations set by Indian and global regulatory bodies. The company’s focus on research and development enables continuous product enhancement and the ability to meet unique customer requirements, strengthening its competitive edge.

With a strong distribution network and customer-centric approach, Balaji Amines Limited has built long-standing relationships with clients across India and overseas, including regions in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company’s dedication to excellence, coupled with ethical business practices and operational transparency, has earned it numerous certifications and accolades over the years. As it continues to expand its product portfolio and technological capabilities, Balaji Amines Limited remains committed to driving growth while contributing positively to the chemical industry and the communities it serves.
